## Modules

- [Accrue](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.md): Accrue — billing state, modeled clearly.
- [Accrue.Actor](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Actor.md): Process-dictionary-backed actor context for the Events ledger (D-15).
- [Accrue.Analytics.Dunning](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Analytics.Dunning.md): Analytics context for Dunning.
- [Accrue.Application](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Application.md): OTP Application module for Accrue — manages boot-time validation and
the supervision tree.
- [Accrue.Auth](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Auth.md): Behaviour + facade for host-app auth integration.
- [Accrue.Auth.Default](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Auth.Default.md): Dev-permissive, prod-refuse-to-boot default `Accrue.Auth` adapter (D-40).
- [Accrue.Auth.Mock](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Auth.Mock.md): Process-local `Accrue.Auth` adapter for host test suites.
- [Accrue.Billable](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billable.md): One-line macro that makes any host schema billable.
- [Accrue.Billing](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.md): Primary context module for Accrue billing operations.
- [Accrue.Billing.Charge](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.Charge.md): Ecto schema for the `accrue_charges` table.
- [Accrue.Billing.ChargeActions](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.ChargeActions.md): Charge / payment intent / setup intent write surface.
- [Accrue.Billing.Coupon](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.Coupon.md): Ecto schema for the `accrue_coupons` table.
- [Accrue.Billing.CouponActions](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.CouponActions.md): Coupon and promotion-code write surface.
- [Accrue.Billing.Customer](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.Customer.md): Ecto schema for the `accrue_customers` table.
- [Accrue.Billing.DiscountMapping](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.DiscountMapping.md): Canonical local discount mapping for Braintree promotion-code resolution.

- [Accrue.Billing.DiscountMappingActions](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.DiscountMappingActions.md): Local write/read/resolve helpers for Braintree discount mappings.

- [Accrue.Billing.Dunning](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.Dunning.md): Pure policy module for dunning.
- [Accrue.Billing.EntitlementSummary](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.EntitlementSummary.md): Ecto schema for `accrue_entitlement_summaries` (ENT-10).
- [Accrue.Billing.IntentResult](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.IntentResult.md): Wraps Stripe intent-capable responses into the `intent_result` tagged
union (D3-06..D3-08).
- [Accrue.Billing.Invoice](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.Invoice.md): Ecto schema for the `accrue_invoices` table.
- [Accrue.Billing.InvoiceActions](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.InvoiceActions.md): Invoice write surface.
- [Accrue.Billing.InvoiceCoupon](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.InvoiceCoupon.md): Ecto schema for the `accrue_invoice_coupons` redemption link table (D3-16).
- [Accrue.Billing.InvoiceItem](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.InvoiceItem.md): Ecto schema for the `accrue_invoice_items` table (D3-15).
- [Accrue.Billing.InvoiceProjection](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.InvoiceProjection.md): Deterministic decomposition of a processor (Stripe- or Fake-shaped)
invoice into a flat attrs map ready for `Accrue.Billing.Invoice.changeset/2`
plus a list of per-line attrs ready for
`Accrue.Billing.InvoiceItem.changeset/2`.
- [Accrue.Billing.Metadata](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.Metadata.md): Stripe-compatible metadata validation and merge helpers.
- [Accrue.Billing.MeterDefinition](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.MeterDefinition.md): Accrue-owned billability contract for one raw usage event name.

- [Accrue.Billing.MeterDefinitions](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.MeterDefinitions.md): Local write/read helpers for Braintree meter definitions.

- [Accrue.Billing.MeterEvent](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.MeterEvent.md): Ecto schema for `accrue_meter_events` — the metered billing audit
ledger and transactional outbox.
- [Accrue.Billing.MeterEventActions](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.MeterEventActions.md): Metered billing write surface.
- [Accrue.Billing.MeterEvents](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.MeterEvents.md): Helper for asynchronous meter-event state transitions driven by
Stripe webhooks.
- [Accrue.Billing.MeteredChargeAttempt](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.MeteredChargeAttempt.md): Durable settlement ledger for one metered renewal window.

- [Accrue.Billing.MeteredChargeAttempts](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.MeteredChargeAttempts.md): Replay-safe settlement state transitions for one metered renewal window.

- [Accrue.Billing.MeteredRenewal](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.MeteredRenewal.md): Immutable local renewal-window anchor for one metered billing period.

- [Accrue.Billing.MeteredRenewalActions](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.MeteredRenewalActions.md): Opens immutable metered renewal windows from canonical Braintree renewal evidence.

- [Accrue.Billing.MeteredRenewalInvoice](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.MeteredRenewalInvoice.md): Authors one canonical local invoice for a closed metered renewal window.

- [Accrue.Billing.PaymentMethod](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.PaymentMethod.md): Ecto schema for the `accrue_payment_methods` table.
- [Accrue.Billing.PaymentMethodActions](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.PaymentMethodActions.md): Payment method orchestration.
- [Accrue.Billing.PromotionCode](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.PromotionCode.md): Ecto schema for the `accrue_promotion_codes` table.
- [Accrue.Billing.PromotionCodeProjection](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.PromotionCodeProjection.md): Decomposes a processor promotion-code map (atom- or string-keyed)
into a flat attrs map ready for
`Accrue.Billing.PromotionCode.changeset/2`.
- [Accrue.Billing.Query](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.Query.md): Composable `Ecto.Query` fragments mirroring the
`Accrue.Billing.Subscription` predicates.
- [Accrue.Billing.Refund](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.Refund.md): Ecto schema for the `accrue_refunds` table (D3-45).
- [Accrue.Billing.RefundActions](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.RefundActions.md): Refund write surface.
- [Accrue.Billing.Search](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.Search.md): Provides native PostgreSQL trigram similarity search for core billing objects.
- [Accrue.Billing.Subscription](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.Subscription.md): Ecto schema for the `accrue_subscriptions` table.
- [Accrue.Billing.SubscriptionActions](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.SubscriptionActions.md): Write surface for subscription lifecycle operations.
- [Accrue.Billing.SubscriptionItem](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.SubscriptionItem.md): Ecto schema for the `accrue_subscription_items` table.
- [Accrue.Billing.SubscriptionItems](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.SubscriptionItems.md): Multi-item subscription surface.
- [Accrue.Billing.SubscriptionProjection](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.SubscriptionProjection.md): Translates a processor subscription response into local Ecto changesets.
- [Accrue.Billing.SubscriptionSchedule](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.SubscriptionSchedule.md): Ecto schema for `accrue_subscription_schedules`.
- [Accrue.Billing.SubscriptionScheduleActions](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.SubscriptionScheduleActions.md): Write surface for Stripe SubscriptionSchedules.
- [Accrue.Billing.SubscriptionScheduleProjection](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.SubscriptionScheduleProjection.md): Decomposes a Stripe/Fake SubscriptionSchedule payload into the flat
attrs map consumed by `Accrue.Billing.SubscriptionSchedule.changeset/2`
and `force_status_changeset/2`.
- [Accrue.Billing.Trial](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.Trial.md): Trial end normalization (D3-38).
- [Accrue.Billing.UpcomingInvoice](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.UpcomingInvoice.md): Non-persistent struct representing a proration preview.
- [Accrue.Billing.UpcomingInvoice.Line](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Billing.UpcomingInvoice.Line.md): A single line on an upcoming-invoice preview.
- [Accrue.BillingPortal](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.BillingPortal.md): Customer Billing Portal context.
- [Accrue.BillingPortal.Session](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.BillingPortal.Session.md): Stripe Customer Billing Portal session wrapper.
- [Accrue.Checkout](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Checkout.md): Stripe Checkout integration facade.
- [Accrue.Checkout.LineItem](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Checkout.LineItem.md): Helpers for constructing Stripe Checkout `line_items` array entries.
- [Accrue.Checkout.LocalSession](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Checkout.LocalSession.md): Persisted local checkout sessions used by processors that route checkout
through a first-party Accrue portal.

- [Accrue.Checkout.Session](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Checkout.Session.md): Checkout handoff wrapper.
- [Accrue.Cldr](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Cldr.md): Provides the core functions to retrieve and manage
the CLDR data that supports formatting and localisation.
- [Accrue.Cldr.AcceptLanguage](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Cldr.AcceptLanguage.md): Parses HTTP `Accept-Language` header values as defined in
[rfc2616](https://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec14.html#sec14.4).
- [Accrue.Cldr.Currency](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Cldr.Currency.md)
- [Accrue.Cldr.Locale](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Cldr.Locale.md): Backend module that provides functions
to define new locales and display human-readable
locale names for presentation purposes.
- [Accrue.Cldr.Money](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Cldr.Money.md): A backend module for Money.
- [Accrue.Cldr.Number](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Cldr.Number.md): Formats numbers and currencies based upon CLDR's decimal formats specification.
- [Accrue.Cldr.Number.Cardinal](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Cldr.Number.Cardinal.md): Implements cardinal plural rules for numbers.

- [Accrue.Cldr.Number.Format](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Cldr.Number.Format.md): Functions to manage the collection of number patterns defined in Cldr.
- [Accrue.Cldr.Number.Formatter.Decimal](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Cldr.Number.Formatter.Decimal.md)
- [Accrue.Cldr.Number.Ordinal](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Cldr.Number.Ordinal.md): Implements ordinal plural rules for numbers.

- [Accrue.Cldr.Number.PluralRule.Range](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Cldr.Number.PluralRule.Range.md): Implements plural rules for ranges
- [Accrue.Cldr.Number.Symbol](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Cldr.Number.Symbol.md)
- [Accrue.Cldr.Number.System](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Cldr.Number.System.md)
- [Accrue.Cldr.Number.Transliterate](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Cldr.Number.Transliterate.md): Transliteration for digits and separators.
- [Accrue.Cldr.Rbnf.NumberSystem](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Cldr.Rbnf.NumberSystem.md): Functions to implement the number system rule-based-number-format rules of CLDR.
- [Accrue.Cldr.Rbnf.Ordinal](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Cldr.Rbnf.Ordinal.md): Functions to implement the ordinal rule-based-number-format rules of CLDR.
- [Accrue.Cldr.Rbnf.Spellout](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Cldr.Rbnf.Spellout.md): Functions to implement the spellout rule-based-number-format rules of CLDR.
- [Accrue.Clock](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Clock.md): Canonical time source for Accrue.
- [Accrue.Config](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Config.md): Runtime configuration schema for Accrue, backed by `NimbleOptions`.
- [Accrue.Connect](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Connect.md): Stripe Connect domain facade.
- [Accrue.Connect.Account](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Connect.Account.md): Ecto schema for `accrue_connect_accounts` — the local projection of a
Stripe Connected Account (D5-02, CONN-01/03).
- [Accrue.Connect.AccountLink](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Connect.AccountLink.md): Onboarding/update bearer credential for a connected account.
- [Accrue.Connect.LoginLink](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Connect.LoginLink.md): Express dashboard return credential for a connected account.
- [Accrue.Connect.PlatformFee](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Connect.PlatformFee.md): Pure `Accrue.Money` math for platform fee computation.
- [Accrue.Connect.Projection](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Connect.Projection.md): Decomposes a processor-shaped (Stripe- or Fake-produced) Connected
Account payload into a flat attrs map ready for
`Accrue.Connect.Account.changeset/2` (D5-02).
- [Accrue.Credo.NoRawStatusAccess](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Credo.NoRawStatusAccess.md): ## Basics
- [Accrue.Dunning](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Dunning.md): Public API for checking dunning state, enabling host applications to 
display in-app banners or alerts for active dunning campaigns without 
false positives from projection lag.

- [Accrue.Dunning.Campaign](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Dunning.Campaign.md): Pure step resolver for the built-in dunning campaign (DUN-02, D-11).
- [Accrue.Dunning.Engine](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Dunning.Engine.md): Behaviour for dunning campaign orchestration engines (DUN-03, D-01).
- [Accrue.Dunning.Engine.Oban](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Dunning.Engine.Oban.md): Built-in dunning engine backed by Oban (DUN-03, D-02).
- [Accrue.Ecto.Money](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Ecto.Money.md): Two storage shapes for `%Accrue.Money{}` in Ecto schemas — both shipped
in Phase 1 per D-02 and RESEARCH Open Question 5.
- [Accrue.Emails.CardExpiringSoon](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Emails.CardExpiringSoon.md): Card-expiring-soon reminder email.

- [Accrue.Entitlements](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Entitlements.md): Public, fail-closed entitlement gate API.
- [Accrue.Entitlements.Admin](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Entitlements.Admin.md): Internal read-only diagnostic seam for the `accrue_admin` entitlements tab
(ENT-11).
- [Accrue.Entitlements.Guard](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Entitlements.Guard.md): The always-compiled, LiveView-runtime-free decision engine shared by both
enforcement surfaces (`Accrue.Plug.RequireEntitlement` and the cond-compiled
`Accrue.Live.Entitlements` `on_mount` guard).
- [Accrue.Entitlements.PastDueGrace](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Entitlements.PastDueGrace.md): Pure, clock-driven past-due grace-window check (ENT-09, D-17).
- [Accrue.Entitlements.Plan](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Entitlements.Plan.md): Pure value struct for a resolved entitlement plan.
- [Accrue.Entitlements.Resolver](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Entitlements.Resolver.md): Behaviour + runtime-dispatch seam for entitlement resolution.
- [Accrue.Entitlements.Resolver.LocalMap](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Entitlements.Resolver.LocalMap.md): Default entitlement resolver — derives a billable's entitlements from
**local subscription state only**, with zero processor calls.
- [Accrue.Entitlements.StripeSync](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Entitlements.StripeSync.md): Read-only observational seam over the optional Stripe-native
entitlement-summary cache (`accrue_entitlement_summaries`, ENT-10).
- [Accrue.Events](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Events.md): Tamper-evident audit ledger for Accrue billing events.
- [Accrue.Events.Event](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Events.Event.md): Ecto schema for a row in the append-only `accrue_events` table.
- [Accrue.Events.Schemas](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Events.Schemas.md): Registry mapping Phase 3 event atoms to their canonical schema
modules (D3-66, D3-68).
- [Accrue.Events.Schemas.CardExpiringSoon](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Events.Schemas.CardExpiringSoon.md): Payload schema for `:"card.expiring_soon"` events (D3-66).

- [Accrue.Events.Upcasters.V1ToV2](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Events.Upcasters.V1ToV2.md): Example upcaster from `schema_version: 1` to `schema_version: 2`.
- [Accrue.Install.Fingerprints](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Install.Fingerprints.md): No-clobber primitives for Accrue-generated host files.

- [Accrue.Install.Options](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Install.Options.md): Strict option parsing for `mix accrue.install`.
- [Accrue.Install.Patches](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Install.Patches.md): Safe host-file patch builders and manual snippets for Accrue installs.
- [Accrue.Install.Project](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Install.Project.md): Phoenix host project discovery for `mix accrue.install`.

- [Accrue.Install.Templates](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Install.Templates.md): Renders host-owned installer templates.

- [Accrue.Integrations.Chimeway](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Integrations.Chimeway.md): Off-by-default Chimeway dunning engine adapter for Accrue (DUN-03).
- [Accrue.Integrations.Chimeway.DunningNotifier](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Integrations.Chimeway.DunningNotifier.md): Bundled `Chimeway.Notifier` implementation for Accrue dunning notifications.
- [Accrue.InvoiceRenderer](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.InvoiceRenderer.md): Behaviour + facade for invoice-specific PDF rendering.
- [Accrue.InvoiceRenderer.ChromicPDF](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.InvoiceRenderer.ChromicPDF.md): Invoice renderer that preserves the existing HEEx-to-ChromicPDF path.
- [Accrue.InvoiceRenderer.Null](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.InvoiceRenderer.Null.md): Null invoice renderer for Chrome-hostile or PDF-disabled deploys.

- [Accrue.InvoiceRenderer.Rendro](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.InvoiceRenderer.Rendro.md): Native Rendro-backed invoice renderer.
- [Accrue.Invoices](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Invoices.md): Invoice facade (D6-04). Owns lazy PDF rendering + storage delegation.
- [Accrue.Invoices.Components](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Invoices.Components.md): Phoenix.Component function components shared by email and PDF.
- [Accrue.Invoices.Layouts](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Invoices.Layouts.md): HEEx layout wrappers for PDF (and optionally, shared email shells).
- [Accrue.Invoices.Render](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Invoices.Render.md): Invoice render orchestration — builds a single `RenderContext` and
exposes format-helper functions shared by the email + PDF pipelines.
- [Accrue.Invoices.RenderContext](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Invoices.RenderContext.md): Format-neutral hydrated invoice payload (D6-04).
- [Accrue.Invoices.Styles](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Invoices.Styles.md): Static branding-aware inline-CSS lookup used by
`Accrue.Invoices.Components` to stamp `style="..."` attributes on every
structural element.
- [Accrue.Jobs.DetectExpiringCards](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Jobs.DetectExpiringCards.md): Scheduled Oban worker for expiring-card detection.
- [Accrue.Jobs.DunningSweeper](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Jobs.DunningSweeper.md): Oban cron worker for the dunning grace-period overlay.
- [Accrue.Jobs.MeterEventsReconciler](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Jobs.MeterEventsReconciler.md): Metered billing outbox reconciler.
- [Accrue.Jobs.MeteredRenewalReconciler](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Jobs.MeteredRenewalReconciler.md): Narrow scheduled backstop for stale Braintree renewal windows.
- [Accrue.Jobs.ProcessMeteredRenewal](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Jobs.ProcessMeteredRenewal.md): Worker-owned BT-06 aggregation path for one metered renewal window.

- [Accrue.Jobs.ReconcileChargeFees](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Jobs.ReconcileChargeFees.md): Daily backstop Oban worker for charge fees that weren't populated at
create time (D3-46).
- [Accrue.Jobs.ReconcileRefundFees](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Jobs.ReconcileRefundFees.md): Daily backstop Oban worker for refund fees that weren't populated at
create time (D3-46).
- [Accrue.Live.Entitlements](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Live.Entitlements.md): `on_mount/4` entitlement guard for host LiveViews (ENT-07).
- [Accrue.Mailer](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Mailer.md): Behaviour + facade for the Accrue transactional email pipeline.
- [Accrue.Mailer.Default](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Mailer.Default.md): Default `Accrue.Mailer` adapter — enqueues an Oban job on the
`:accrue_mailers` queue that a worker later turns into a delivered email.
- [Accrue.Mailer.Swoosh](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Mailer.Swoosh.md): Swoosh-backed delivery module for Accrue's transactional emails.
- [Accrue.Mailer.Test](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Mailer.Test.md): Test adapter for `Accrue.Mailer` (D6-05). Replaces `Accrue.Mailer.Default`
at the behaviour layer — intercepts `Accrue.Mailer.deliver/2` BEFORE
Oban enqueue. Sends the intent tuple to the calling test pid and
returns immediately.
- [Accrue.Money](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Money.md): Accrue's canonical money value type — a thin, opinionated wrapper over the
`:ex_money` currency table.
- [Accrue.Oban.Middleware](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Oban.Middleware.md): Helper for setting `Accrue.Actor` operation_id from an Oban job (D3-63).
- [Accrue.PDF](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.PDF.md): Behaviour + facade for legacy HTML-to-PDF rendering.
- [Accrue.PDF.ChromicPDF](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.PDF.ChromicPDF.md): ChromicPDF adapter for `Accrue.PDF` (D-32, D-33).
- [Accrue.PDF.Null](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.PDF.Null.md): Null `Accrue.PDF` adapter for Chrome-hostile deploys (D6-06).
- [Accrue.PDF.Test](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.PDF.Test.md): Chrome-free `Accrue.PDF` adapter for test environments (D-34).
- [Accrue.PlanResolver](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.PlanResolver.md): Host-owned resolver for plan metadata that the shared `price_id` facade
does not carry by itself.
- [Accrue.Plug.PutConnectedAccount](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Plug.PutConnectedAccount.md): Stashes a per-request Connect `stripe_account` id into the process
dictionary for the lifetime of the request.
- [Accrue.Plug.PutOperationId](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Plug.PutOperationId.md): Sets `Accrue.Actor` operation_id from `conn.assigns[:request_id]`.
- [Accrue.Plug.RequireEntitlement](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Plug.RequireEntitlement.md): A controller-pipeline guard that halts a request unless the resolved billable
is entitled to a `feature:` (or holds an active `plan:`).
- [Accrue.Portal.Checkout.CompletionJob](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Portal.Checkout.CompletionJob.md): Asynchronously records and reduces the synthetic local-portal checkout
completion event after a successful Braintree subscribe handoff.

- [Accrue.Processor](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Processor.md): The adapter contract between Accrue and payment processors.
- [Accrue.Processor.Braintree](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Processor.Braintree.md): Production Braintree adapter for the gateway subscription core slice.

- [Accrue.Processor.Capabilities](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Processor.Capabilities.md): Capability map for bounded processor slices.
- [Accrue.Processor.Fake](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Processor.Fake.md): Deterministic in-memory `Accrue.Processor` adapter for tests and demos.
- [Accrue.Processor.Fake.State](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Processor.Fake.State.md): Internal state struct for `Accrue.Processor.Fake`.
- [Accrue.Processor.Idempotency](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Processor.Idempotency.md): Deterministic idempotency key and subject UUID derivation for Phase 3
processor operations (D3-60, D3-61, D3-64).
- [Accrue.Processor.Stripe](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Processor.Stripe.md): Production Stripe adapter — wires all `Accrue.Processor` callbacks to
`:lattice_stripe`.
- [Accrue.Processor.Stripe.ErrorMapper](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Processor.Stripe.ErrorMapper.md): Translates raw `LatticeStripe` error shapes into `Accrue.Error` subtypes.
- [Accrue.Repo](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Repo.md): Thin facade over the host-configured `Ecto.Repo`.
- [Accrue.Router](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Router.md): Router helpers for mounting Accrue webhook endpoints.
- [Accrue.Storage](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Storage.md): Behaviour + facade for pluggable PDF / asset storage.
- [Accrue.Storage.Null](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Storage.Null.md): No-op `Accrue.Storage` adapter — the v1.0 default (D6-04).
- [Accrue.Stripe](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Stripe.md): Stripe-specific helpers for host applications (D2-15).
- [Accrue.Telemetry](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Telemetry.md): Telemetry conventions and helpers for Accrue.
- [Accrue.Telemetry.Metrics](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Telemetry.Metrics.md): Default `Telemetry.Metrics` recipe for SRE teams.
- [Accrue.Telemetry.OTel](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Telemetry.OTel.md): Optional OpenTelemetry bridge for Accrue telemetry spans.
- [Accrue.Telemetry.Ops](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Telemetry.Ops.md): Ops-grade telemetry emit helper.
- [Accrue.Test](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Test.md): Public test helper facade for host applications.
- [Accrue.Test.Clock](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Test.Clock.md): Deterministic clock helpers for host tests.
- [Accrue.Test.EventAssertions](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Test.EventAssertions.md): ExUnit-style assertions for Accrue's append-only event ledger.
- [Accrue.Test.Factory](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Test.Factory.md): Phase 3 test factories (D3-79..85).
- [Accrue.Test.Generators](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Test.Generators.md): StreamData generators for Phase 3 property tests (D3-81).
- [Accrue.Test.MailerAssertions](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Test.MailerAssertions.md): ExUnit-style assertions for `Accrue.Mailer.Test` intent captures
(D6-05). Symmetric with `Accrue.Test.PdfAssertions`.
- [Accrue.Test.PdfAssertions](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Test.PdfAssertions.md): ExUnit-style assertions for `Accrue.PDF.Test` render captures (D-34).
Symmetric with `Accrue.Test.MailerAssertions`.
- [Accrue.Test.Webhooks](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Test.Webhooks.md): Synthetic webhook helpers for host tests.
- [Accrue.Webhook.CachingBodyReader](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Webhook.CachingBodyReader.md): Custom body reader for `Plug.Parsers` that tees the raw body into
`conn.assigns[:raw_body]` for webhook signature verification.
- [Accrue.Webhook.ConnectHandler](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Webhook.ConnectHandler.md): Webhook handler for events arriving on the `:connect` endpoint.
- [Accrue.Webhook.DefaultHandler](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Webhook.DefaultHandler.md): Non-disableable default handler for built-in state reconciliation.
- [Accrue.Webhook.DispatchWorker](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Webhook.DispatchWorker.md): Oban worker for async webhook handler dispatch.
- [Accrue.Webhook.Event](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Webhook.Event.md): Lean event struct passed to webhook handlers.
- [Accrue.Webhook.Handler](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Webhook.Handler.md): Behaviour for webhook event handlers (D2-27).
- [Accrue.Webhook.Ingest](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Webhook.Ingest.md): Transactional webhook event persistence and Oban job dispatch (D2-24).
- [Accrue.Webhook.Plug](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Webhook.Plug.md): Core webhook ingestion plug.
- [Accrue.Webhook.Pruner](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Webhook.Pruner.md): Oban cron worker for webhook event retention (D2-34).
- [Accrue.Webhook.Signature](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Webhook.Signature.md): Webhook signature verification. Delegates entirely to
`LatticeStripe.Webhook.construct_event!/4` (D2-22).
- [Accrue.Webhook.WebhookEvent](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Webhook.WebhookEvent.md): Ecto schema for the `accrue_webhook_events` table.
- [Accrue.Webhooks.DLQ](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Webhooks.DLQ.md): Dead-letter queue replay and retention for webhook events.
- [Accrue.Workers.DunningStep](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Workers.DunningStep.md): Durable, cancel-guarded, Oban-unique dunning-campaign step worker
(DUN-02, DUN-05; D-10, D-11, D-16).
- [Accrue.Workers.Mailer](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Workers.Mailer.md): Oban worker that delivers a transactional email asynchronously.

- Exceptions
  - [Accrue.APIError](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.APIError.md): Raised when a processor call fails for a reason that is neither a card
error nor a rate limit (e.g., HTTP 500, unexpected payload). Pattern-match
on `%Accrue.APIError{}` in retry logic.
  - [Accrue.ActionRequiredError](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.ActionRequiredError.md): Raised when a Stripe PaymentIntent or SetupIntent transitions to
`requires_action` (SCA / 3DS). The `:payment_intent` field carries the
full PaymentIntent payload so callers can extract `client_secret` and
drive the Stripe.js confirmation flow on the frontend.
  - [Accrue.Auth.StepUpUnconfigured](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Auth.StepUpUnconfigured.md): Raised when a destructive admin action requires step-up verification but
the configured auth adapter does not implement the optional callbacks.

  - [Accrue.CardError](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.CardError.md): Raised when the processor rejects a card (declined, expired, insufficient
funds, etc.). Mirrors Stripe's card-error shape 1:1.
  - [Accrue.ConfigError](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.ConfigError.md): Raised when `Accrue.Config` validation fails, or when a key is looked up
that is neither set at runtime nor has a schema default.

  - [Accrue.DecodeError](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.DecodeError.md): Raised when a processor response body cannot be decoded (malformed JSON,
unexpected shape). The `payload` field holds the raw binary for
debugging — treat as sensitive; do not log verbatim.

  - [Accrue.Error.DiscountMappingInvalid](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Error.DiscountMappingInvalid.md): Raised when a stored local discount mapping is present but cannot be
resolved safely because the canonical local row has drifted into an
invalid state.

  - [Accrue.Error.InvalidState](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Error.InvalidState.md): Raised when a state-machine transition is attempted from an illegal
source state (e.g., `pay_invoice/2` on a `:void` invoice, `resume/2`
on an `:active` subscription).

  - [Accrue.Error.InvoiceRendererUnavailable](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Error.InvoiceRendererUnavailable.md): Returned when the explicitly configured invoice renderer cannot run due to a
stable host misconfiguration.
  - [Accrue.Error.MeteredSettlementConflict](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Error.MeteredSettlementConflict.md): Raised when a metered renewal attempts to create a second settlement unit
for a period that already has a canonical charge attempt.

  - [Accrue.Error.MeteredSettlementMissingPrerequisite](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Error.MeteredSettlementMissingPrerequisite.md): Raised when a metered renewal settlement is attempted before the renewal
has the local billing truth required for money movement.

  - [Accrue.Error.MultiItemSubscription](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Error.MultiItemSubscription.md): Raised when a legacy convenience call (e.g., `update_quantity/3`) is
made against a subscription that has more than one `SubscriptionItem`.
Multi-item subscriptions require `Accrue.Billing.update_items/3`; the
convenience helpers enforce a single-item invariant.

  - [Accrue.Error.NoDefaultPaymentMethod](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Error.NoDefaultPaymentMethod.md): Raised when a charge or subscription call requires a default payment
method and the customer has none set. Callers should surface a
user-facing "add a payment method" prompt.

  - [Accrue.Error.NotAttached](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Error.NotAttached.md): Raised when a payment method is referenced for a customer it is not
attached to (e.g., `set_default_payment_method/3` with a `pm_id` that
belongs to a different customer).

  - [Accrue.Error.PdfDisabled](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Error.PdfDisabled.md): Raised / returned when the configured PDF adapter is `Accrue.PDF.Null`.
Expected and terminal — callers MUST pattern-match and fall
through to a non-PDF path (e.g., link to `hosted_invoice_url` instead
of attaching a rendered binary). Oban workers MUST NOT treat this as
a transient retry; it is a stable adapter configuration, not a
failure.

  - [Accrue.EventLedgerImmutableError](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.EventLedgerImmutableError.md): Raised when a caller attempts to UPDATE or DELETE a row in
`accrue_events`. The append-only guarantee is enforced in two places
  - [Accrue.IdempotencyError](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.IdempotencyError.md): Raised when the processor rejects an idempotency key replay (e.g., same
key used for a different request body). Pattern-match on
`%Accrue.IdempotencyError{}` to surface a user-facing "this request was
already processed" message.

  - [Accrue.Money.MismatchedCurrencyError](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.Money.MismatchedCurrencyError.md): Raised when `Accrue.Money` arithmetic is attempted across two different
currencies. Per D-04, cross-currency math never silently coerces or returns
a tagged tuple — it raises at the call site so the bug surfaces immediately.

  - [Accrue.PDF.RenderFailed](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.PDF.RenderFailed.md): Raised from `Accrue.Workers.Mailer.perform/1` when
`Accrue.Billing.render_invoice_pdf/2` returns a non-terminal
`{:error, reason}` (i.e., not `%Accrue.Error.PdfDisabled{}` and not
`%Accrue.Error.InvoiceRendererUnavailable{}`). Raising this exception lets
Oban backoff handle transient render failures — the mailer job is retried
per its `max_attempts` setting.
  - [Accrue.RateLimitError](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.RateLimitError.md): Raised when the processor returns a rate-limit response (HTTP 429). The
`retry_after` field carries the server's suggested backoff in seconds.

  - [Accrue.SetupDiagnostic](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.SetupDiagnostic.md): Shared setup-diagnostic carrier for first-hour host misconfiguration.

  - [Accrue.SignatureError](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Accrue.SignatureError.md): Raised when a webhook signature fails verification. This is
NEVER returned as a tuple — a bad signature is either a misconfiguration
or an attacker, and neither is recoverable at the call site. The webhook
plug translates this raise into an HTTP 400.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix accrue.gen.handler](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Accrue.Gen.Handler.md): Generates a host-owned Accrue webhook handler scaffold.
Generated files are stamped with `# accrue:generated` by
`Accrue.Install.Fingerprints`.
- [mix accrue.install](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Accrue.Install.md): Generates host-owned Accrue wiring.
- [mix accrue.webhooks.prune](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Accrue.Webhooks.Prune.md): Manually trigger the same retention sweep that `Accrue.Webhook.Pruner`
runs on its Oban cron schedule. Useful for ops engineers who want to
reclaim DB space without waiting for the next scheduled run.
- [mix accrue.webhooks.replay](https://accrue.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Accrue.Webhooks.Replay.md): Requeue dead-lettered webhook events from the command line.
